description: Evaluation of raw CSV experimental table rows against lunar exploration atmosphere conditions (O2 >= 30% and Pressure <= 10.2 psi). Scoped strictly to table rows.

PSI-69.both_verdict: 0 rows in the table combine O2 >= 30% AND pressure <= 10.2 psi
PSI-69.near_miss_note: Near-miss: every FLEX row with O2 >= 30% operates at pressure >= 10.33 psi (534.3 mmHg to 770.6 mmHg, spanning 10.33 to 14.91 psi).

PSI-10.rule_4_note: Rule 4 & Condition 5: Flame Design X_O2 = 'reported oxidizer O2 mole fraction' in gaseous diffusion flames; not cabin air.

summary.verdict: Across all 19 ingested experimental tables (1,823 total rows), EXACTLY 0 flight test rows combine cabin O2 >= 30% and chamber pressure <= 10.2 psi.
summary.closest_liquid_droplet: PSI-69 FLEX tested O2 >= 30% (24 rows), but all at pressure >= 10.33 psi (10.33 to 14.91 psi). PSI-68 FLEX-2 candidate parameter sets reach 30% O2 and 0.5 atm (7.35 psi), but combinations were not confirmed row-by-row in flight table.
summary.closest_solid_fuel: PSI-25 BASS-II tested initial O2 up to 22.2% across 129 rows (max 22.2%, strictly below >= 30% lunar atmosphere); chamber pressure is not reported.
summary.gaseous_burner_isolation: PSI-159 CFI-G has 20 rows at 7.35 psi with burner O2 35.85-39.26% and PSI-10 Flame Design has 18 rows at 6.26-7.57 psi with oxidizer O2 31.97-85.0%, but these are strictly co-flow burner oxidizer streams, NEVER cabin air (Rule 4).
summary.acme_bre_pressure_policy: PSI-20 ACME BRE tested O2 up to 40%, but chamber pressure is NOT reported in table rows ('chamber pressures were also varied but are not identified in this summary table'). Per rule, reported as 'pressure not reported', never counted as a match or a miss.
